selection.rule: highest pooled leave-one-app-out endpoint-param macro-F1 over all 6 training groups; hyperparameters and threshold then chosen by inner LOAO over all 6 groups
selection.note: LR is also best on third-party apps; RF fails NodeGoat XSS (0.0) in LOAO. LR and LightGBM often chose the top of the threshold grid (0.9); the grid was not widened after seeing outer results.

freeze.rule: DVNA rows are excluded by dastml.dataset.load() unless final=True; scored exactly once by scripts/eval_final.py

history.change: re-featurized from unchanged raw records after fixing specials_kept (page markup next to a reflection was counted as kept payload characters); DVNA not yet scored

metric: endpoint-param macro-F1 over classes present, per-class P/R/F1, row-level macro-F1, cluster bootstrap 1000
